items.answer: A reaction that releases thermal energy to its surroundings
A reaction that absorbs thermal energy from its surroundings

items.prompt: A hand warmer gets hot. Exothermic or endothermic?

items.answer: Use more reactant so more heat is released

items.prompt: Why do engineers test a device before finalizing it?
items.answer: To see if it works as intended and find what to improve

items.prompt: Why might a cold pack be designed to react slowly?
items.answer: So it stays cold for a longer time

steps: A slower reaction spreads the cooling out.

items.prompt: Describe the energy flow in an exothermic reaction.
items.answer: Thermal energy moves from the reaction to the surroundings

steps: Exothermic reactions give off heat to the surroundings.
